data.one_liner: Flutter UI kit offering Neubrutalism‑style widgets like buttons, cards and navigation components.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of ready‑made Neubrutalism‑inspired widgets such as NeuTextButton, NeuIconButton, NeuBottomNav and NeuContainer. The widgets are customizable for colors, sizes, shadows and optional bounce animations.
use_when: You need a consistent Neubrutalism visual style across Android, iOS, web and desktop apps
You want ready‑made, customizable neumorphic‑like widgets without writing them from scratch
avoid_when: Your design requires a different visual language or highly custom animations
You need state‑management, networking or backend integration (the package only provides UI)
strengths: Simple customization of colors, border radius and animation offsets
Supports all major Flutter platforms out of the box
weaknesses: Limited to a single design style, not suitable for other UI themes
Breaking API changes between major versions
No code‑generation or advanced theming utilities
data.minimal_example:
NeuTextButton(
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
  buttonColor: const Color.fromARGB(255, 236, 199, 211),
  buttonHeight: 60,
  buttonWidth: 100,
  enableAnimation: true,
  text: const Text('Hello', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
);
